productName: French Country Full Guard Rail Kit
description:
French Country Full Guard Rail Kit is the full-length guard rail for the French Country cribs, not a separate standalone bed. Ensure your toddler sleeps soundly and safely with the Full-Length Guard Rail.

Designed to fit convertible cribs in toddler or bed mode after conversion, this rail runs the entire length of the bed for maximum security. The guard rail is crafted from solid wood with a durable finish that matches your furniture. Simple attachment hardware makes installation quick and tool-free.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
